{{dablink|For other uses of the word "wind," part of the meaning of Aldieb, see [[Wind]].}}
'''Aldieb''' is a white mare belonging to [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine Sedai]].{{Ref/book|1|13}} Her name means West Wind in the [[Old Tongue]], the wind that brings the spring rains.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Aldieb}} She is described as very graceful. She has been ridden to and from many places. She has been to the [[Two Rivers]]{{Ref/book|1|13}}, [[Shadar Logoth]]{{Ref/book|1|19}}, [[Caemlyn]]{{Ref/book|1|44}}, the [[Ways]] {{Ref/book|1|45}}, [[Fal Dara]]{{Ref/book|1|47}}, the [[Blight]]{{Ref/book|1|48}}, the [[Eye of the World]]{{Ref/book|1|53}}, [[Ghealdan]]{{Ref/book|3|7}}, [[Illian]]{{Ref/book|3|44}}, [[Tear]], the [[Aiel Waste]], [[Rhuidean]]{{Ref/book|4|22}}, [[Jangai Pass]]{{Ref/book|5|20}}, and [[Cairhien]]{{Ref/book|5|53}}. Following Moiraine's disappearance and presumed death, she was stabled indefinitely at the [[Sun Palace]].<ref>This was mentioned in a now defunct [[Tor.com]] Website Q&A.</ref>
